exact_new_parent_tests.name: sqlite::native_custody_tests::guarded_pool_retains_custody_when_native_open_is_cancelled
exact_new_parent_tests.mechanism: Owned ordinary libtest subprocess holds a real File lock. sqlite3_auto_extension blocks during native open; the real state opening future is actively polled to the callback then cancelled. Parent independently opens/try_locks in another process while child gate is still zero; after release and actual resource destruction, lock succeeds.
exact_new_parent_tests.expected: WouldBlock before native gate release; gate_status=0 is checked after physical probe. After native close: lock available and gate_status=1; child exits successfully and is reaped.

exact_new_parent_tests.name: sqlite::native_custody_tests::coordinated_pool_retains_custody_when_initial_pragma_is_cancelled
exact_new_parent_tests.mechanism: Same physical cross-process proof, with a real SQLite progress callback paused during initial statement execution. The actual coordinated state constructor is used. Its before_checkout is a deliberate panic sentinel because it must not be reached before cancelled initialization finishes; it is not a successful no-op coordinator.
exact_new_parent_tests.expected: Same physical lock/gate proof. Any successful early open, checkout sentinel, callback timeout or cleanup failure does not qualify.

exact_new_parent_tests.name: production_writer::objective_sender::connection_custody_tests::native_custody_survives_removal_of_both_registered_anchors
exact_new_parent_tests.mechanism: Open the actual CognitiveStore, detach a real connection, close the store, verify live SELECT and real exclusive OpenGuard contention.
